description: From a proof of \(\forall x\,A(x)\), universal elimination gives a proof of \(A(t)\), where \(t\) is any closed term.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof.allElim.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {Γ : Finset (L.Formula α)} {φ : L.BoundedFormula α 1} (t : L.Term α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ φ.all) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Proof L Γ
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.instantiate φ t)
